experiment: Domain Shift Analysis: ASVspoof 2019 vs 2021 (Real Data)
source: ASVspoof 2019 LA eval (71237 files, fixed v4 features)
target: ASVspoof 2021 DF eval (181566 files, original v4 features)
conclusion: Domain shift varies significantly by feature type (all p<0.01), confirming Theorem 6 decomposition principle. Prosody features show least domain shift, PNCC features show most.
